```typescript
import * as pulumi from "@pulumi/pulumi";
import * as std from "@pulumi/std";
import * as tencentcloud from "@tencentcloud_iac/pulumi";

const wedataWorkflowFolder = new tencentcloud.wedata.WorkflowFolder("wedata_workflow_folder", {
    projectId: "2905622749543821312",
    parentFolderPath: "/",
    folderName: "tftest",
});
const wedataWorkflow = new tencentcloud.wedata.Workflow("wedata_workflow", {
    projectId: "2905622749543821312",
    workflowName: "test_workflow1",
    parentFolderPath: pulumi.interpolate`${wedataWorkflowFolder.parentFolderPath}${wedataWorkflowFolder.folderName}`,
    workflowType: "cycle",
});
const wedataTask = new tencentcloud.wedata.Task("wedata_task", {
    projectId: "2905622749543821312",
    taskBaseAttribute: {
        taskName: "tfTask",
        taskTypeId: "30",
        workflowId: wedataWorkflow.workflowId,
    },
    taskConfiguration: {
        codeContent: std.base64encode({
            input: "Hello World",
        }).then(invoke => invoke.result),
        taskExtConfigurationLists: [
            {
                paramKey: "bucket",
                paramValue: "wedata-fusion-bjjr-1257305158",
            },
            {
                paramKey: "ftp.file.name",
                paramValue: "/datastudio/project/2905622749543821312/tftest/test_workflow1/tfTask.py",
            },
            {
                paramKey: "tenantId",
                paramValue: "1257305158",
            },
            {
                paramKey: "region",
                paramValue: "ap-beijing-fsi",
            },
            {
                paramKey: "extraInfo",
                paramValue: "{\"fromMapping\":false}",
            },
            {
                paramKey: "ssmDynamicSkSwitch",
                paramValue: "ON",
            },
            {
                paramKey: "calendar_open",
                paramValue: "0",
            },
            {
                paramKey: "specLabelConfItems",
                paramValue: "eyJzcGVjTGFiZWxDb25mSXRlbXMiOltdfQ==",
            },
            {
                paramKey: "waitExecutionTotalTTL",
                paramValue: "-1",
            },
        ],
    },
    taskSchedulerConfiguration: {
        cycleType: "DAY_CYCLE",
    },
});
```

```go
func main() {
	pulumi.Run(func(ctx *pulumi.Context) error {
		wedataWorkflowFolder, err := wedata.NewWorkflowFolder(ctx, "wedata_workflow_folder", &wedata.WorkflowFolderArgs{
			ProjectId:        pulumi.String("2905622749543821312"),
			ParentFolderPath: pulumi.String("/"),
			FolderName:       pulumi.String("tftest"),
		})
		if err != nil {
			return err
		}
		wedataWorkflow, err := wedata.NewWorkflow(ctx, "wedata_workflow", &wedata.WorkflowArgs{
			ProjectId:    pulumi.String("2905622749543821312"),
			WorkflowName: pulumi.String("test_workflow1"),
```

```java
                var folderName = values.t2;
                return String.format("%s%s", parentFolderPath,folderName);
            }))
            .workflowType("cycle")
            .build());

        var wedataTask = new Task("wedataTask", TaskArgs.builder()
            .projectId("2905622749543821312")

                        .paramKey("region")

                        .build(),
                    TaskTaskConfigurationTaskExtConfigurationListArgs.builder()
                        .paramKey("extraInfo")
                        .paramValue("{\"fromMapping\":false}")
                        .build(),
                    TaskTaskConfigurationTaskExtConfigurationListArgs.builder()
                        .paramKey("ssmDynamicSkSwitch")
```

<div>

            title="Optional">
        <span id="pollingnullstrategy_csharp">
<a data-swiftype-name="resource-property" data-swiftype-type="text" href="#pollingnullstrategy_csharp" style="color: inherit; text-decoration: inherit;">Polling<wbr>Null<wbr>Strategy</a>
</span>
        <span class="property-indicator"></span>
        <span class="property-type">string</span>
    </dt>
    <dd>Strategy for waiting for upstream task instances: EXECUTING; WAITING.</dd><dt class="property-optional"
            title="Optional">
        <span id="taskdependencyexecutingstrategies_csharp">

</span>
        <span class="property-indicator"></span>
        <span class="property-type">List&lt;string&gt;</span>
    </dt>
    <dd>This field is required only when PollingNullStrategy is EXECUTING, List type: NOT_EXIST (default, when minute depends on minute/hour depends on hour, parent instance is not within the downstream instance scheduling time range); PARENT_EXPIRED (parent instance failed); PARENT_TIMEOUT (parent instance timed out). If any of the above scenarios is met, the parent task instance dependency judgment can be passed; otherwise, it is necessary to wait for the parent instance.</dd><dt class="property-optional"
            title="Optional">
        <span id="taskdependencyexecutingtimeoutvalue_csharp">

    </dt>
    <dd>This field is required only when TaskDependencyExecutingStrategies contains PARENT_TIMEOUT, the timeout time for downstream tasks depending on parent instance execution, unit: minutes.</dd></dl>
</pulumi-choosable>

